simah_consent_intro: Madark requires your consent to verify your credit information with the Saudi Credit Bureau (Simah) before processing your financing request.
simah_consent_s1_body: By providing your consent, you authorize Madark to request and obtain your credit report from Simah to assess your eligibility for financing.
simah_consent_s2_body: Madark will access your credit history and score, your existing financial obligations, and your repayment record as held by Simah.
simah_consent_s3_body: The information obtained from Simah will be used solely to evaluate your financing request and to determine the financing limit and terms offered to you.
simah_consent_s4_body: All information obtained from Simah will be handled confidentially, stored securely, and will not be shared with any third party except as required by law.
simah_consent_s5_body: This consent is valid for the duration of your financing relationship with Madark, including any related reviews or updates.
simah_consent_s6_body: You have the right to withdraw your consent at any time by contacting Madark support. Withdrawing consent may affect the processing of your financing requests.
simah_consent_s7_body: This consent process complies with the regulations of the Saudi Central Bank (SAMA) and the applicable laws governing credit information in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.
